luca: Heads-up — need a quick decision on v4p1 quant rollout. Short AB summary + proposed gate below; want a deterministic tie-breaker so we don't oscillate.
maria: Ran the 20k eval slice yesterday (seeded slices + production shadow). Quick numbers (A=prod, B=v4p1-q4):
  - EM (mean): A=78.4% | B=78.7% (+0.3)
  - Hallucination rate (detected): A=1.2% | B=1.9% (+0.7)
  - p95 latency: A=290ms | B=230ms (-60ms)
  - token_cost: B ~ -18% 
  - concordance_overall: A=0.913 | B=0.901 (-0.012)
  - concordance_longdoc(>1k): A=0.88 | B=0.82 (-0.06)
maria: run id: `eval-172905-20k-v4p1` — bootstrap CI on hallucination delta ~ +/-0.25 (so the +0.7 is borderline but notable on the longdoc slice)
vikram: TL;DR: B is faster and cheaper, small EM uplift, but clear longdoc concordance loss and higher hallucination. We should avoid a naive promote.
vikram: Proposal: implement a "streakgate" policy for this promo:
  - evaluate in rolling 1h windows during canary. A window is PASS if: hallucination_delta <= +0.4 AND EM_delta >= -0.2 (both relative to prod) OR concordance_overall >= 0.9.
  - require 3 consecutive PASS windows to advance traffic (streak = 3).
  - tiebreaker if streak broken by single window: prefer safety — i.e., if hallucination_delta > +0.5 OR concordance_longdoc drops >0.04, block and require manual review.
  - auto-rollback immediate if any 2 consecutive windows show hallucination_delta > +0.8 OR EM_delta <-0.5.
jen: +1 to streak idea. Additional suggestion: use longdoc concordance as the first tiebreaker for longform customers — if concordance_longdoc delta > -0.03 AND halluc_delta < +0.6, allow the tie to resolve toward B; otherwise default to A.
jen: Small operational detail: initial rollout plan: 5% for 30m (collect 1h windows overlapping), if streak passes -> 20% for 60m, if streak passes again -> 100%.
luca: Proposed config snippet (for ops team):
```
streak_gate:
  window: 1h
  required_streak: 3
  pass_conditions:
    - halluc_delta <= 0.4
    - em_delta >= -0.2
  tiebreaker_order: [concordance_longdoc, hallucination_delta, em_delta]
  rollback_triggers:
    - consecutive_windows: 2
      condition: halluc_delta > 0.8
    - consecutive_windows: 2
      condition: em_delta < -0.5
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling canary `promo/v4p1-q4` to start in 15m. Will abort if any rollback_triggers fire. dashboard: https://console.internal/reports/eval-172905 (shadow link)
maria: Note about stats: current sample CI wide for longdoc metrics — recommend running an extended longdoc concordance check against 50k longdoc samples before the 20% step.
vikram: Action items: 1) maria -> run extended concordance job: `eval-longdoc-50k-172905` 2) jen -> add streak_gate config to promo job (I can review PR) 3) luca -> schedule promo window and notify oncall. I'll open PR #8421 with the config change.
jen: :thumbsup: if no objections we'll merge config and start canary. @safety-bot FYI — please wire the post-deploy hallucination monitor.
safety-bot: safety-bot: acknowledged. Will attach a 10m sliding alert if hallucination_rate > 0.5 absolute (or +0.3 delta) and will file a P0 if persists > 15m.
luca: Merging in 5 unless objections. Tagging oncall @kevin for coverage.
kevin: oncall acked — I'll watch the first 2 windows and can pause traffic if anything looks off.
jen: Thanks all — keeping a manual hold if the longdoc concordance job flags anything.
